title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics telemetry enhancements
author: Priya Patel
description: Add additional telemetry hooks and metrics to the oncall autodiagnostics pipeline to improve SLO correlation and root-cause prioritization. Motivation: during recent incidents we observed missing visibility into which runbook checks and SLO hints were executed and their latencies. This change: 1) emits per-runbook execution metrics (runbook.name, outcome, duration_ms, source), 2) tags autodiagnostic suggestions with SLO context and confidence score, 3) adds a lightweight sampling counter to limit high-cardinality traffic, 4) provides an opt-in config flag (TELEMETRY_AUTODIAG=true) for staging rollouts, and 5) updates dashboards and alerts. Checklist: - [x] metrics schema defined and documented (docs/telemetry/autodiag-metrics.md) - [x] minimal performance impact (microbenchmarks + sampling) - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] dashboard queries added - [x] documented rollout plan and opt-in flag Links: Linear ENG-2345; design notes: https://redwood.internal/docs/autodiag-telemetry. Migration: config default is off; ops should enable in staging and validate dashboards before enabling in prod.
commits: feat: emit runbook.execution.duration_ms and runbook.execution.outcome with labels
feat: include slo_context and confidence_score in suggestion payloads
chore: add TELEMETRY_AUTODIAG env flag and config validation
test: add unit tests for telemetry serialization
test: e2e test for oncall autodiag execution visibility
patch_snippet: +func emitRunbookMetric(name string, outcome string, durMs int, source string) { reporter.Gauge("incidentbot.runbook.execution.duration_ms", float64(durMs), map[string]string{"runbook": name, "outcome": outcome, "source": source}) }

release_notes: Enhancement: oncall autodiagnostics now emit per-runbook execution metrics and SLO-context tags; new opt-in TELEMETRY_AUTODIAG flag for staged rollouts; dashboards and dashboard queries added for validation.
notes_for_ops: Default config is disabled. Enable TELEMETRY_AUTODIAG in staging, validate dashboards (docs/telemetry/autodiag-metrics.md), then roll out to prod. Sampling limits: default 1% for high-cardinality runbooks; increase only after perf validation.
